guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low (asynchronous reset), all elements of key_init_q are cleared to 0.
When rst_ni is high and key_init_we[s][i] equals SP2V_HIGH, at the next posedge clk_i, key_init_q[s][i] is loaded with key_init_d[s][i].
When rst_ni is high and key_init_we[s][i] is not equal to SP2V_HIGH, key_init_q[s][i] retains its previous value.

assumptions.claim: key_init_we signals must be synchronous to clk_i and meet setup/hold timing.
assumptions.risk: If not synchronized, metastability or spurious writes could corrupt key_init_q.

assumptions.claim: When key_init_we[s][i] == SP2V_HIGH, key_init_d[s][i] must contain valid key data.
assumptions.cond: rising edge of clk_i while write enable is asserted
assumptions.risk: Invalid data results in a wrong key being loaded, potentially compromising encryption.

uncertain_points.claim: After reset, key_init_q is all zeros. If the AES core can start operations before a valid key is written, encryption proceeds with a known all-zero key.
uncertain_points.risk: Exposure of secrets or weak cryptographic output due to predictable key.

uncertain_points.claim: key_init_we is assumed synchronous to clk_i; no internal synchronization. If generated asynchronously, metastability may occur.
uncertain_points.cond: if key_init_we is not synchronous with clk_i
uncertain_points.risk: Corrupted key register content from timing violations.
